heroHeadline: Wind and Solar Beat Gas Globally for First Time — IEA: Solar Investment to Hit $365 Billion in 2026
heroSubtitle: 3,820 days since the Paris Agreement — Ember confirmed that in April 2026, wind and solar generated 531 TWh globally vs. 477 TWh for gas, the first month in history that combined wind+solar exceeded natural gas worldwide. Five years ago (April 2021), gas was more than double wind+solar combined. The IEA's World Energy Investment 2026 (May 28) confirmed solar investment alone will reach $365 billion in 2026, with total renewables at $665 billion — for the first time, clean energy commands the majority of all global energy spending. U.S. renewables surged 11.1% in Q1 2026, reaching 28.6% of U.S. electricity generation with solar up 23.9%. India's energy investment is set for a record $170 billion in 2026, growing 11% annually.
footerNote: Data sourced from IEA, IRENA, Ember, BloombergNEF, and major international outlets. All figures reflect verified, publicly available data through May 2026.
